page.layout: One printed page, numbered 167 at top right, with running head "NOTÆ" at top left. Main text in one column, left. Marginal notes in the right margin: "Pag. 6.17." beside the middle of the text, and "Et v.lib." with Arabic words beside the lower part. Catchword "Z" and a small Arabic word at the foot of the column.

main_text.p: rarum, atque scientiarum inimicum esse religioni & è rebus publicis Christianis penitus tollendum, sufficere unicuique linguam vernaculam, & quicquid temporis aliis impenditur, futiliter perdi. Mirum certè eam, quæ compendiosa Juliano visa est ad religionem Christianam è medio tollendam via, unicam nunc esse ejus promovendæ rationem. Sed ut eò unde digressi sumus revertamur: Foveнтibus apud Arabes Almamone, & qui ipsi in Imperio successerunt bonas literas, eousque tandem (verba sunt Magni Saavilii) studio & ingenio profecerunt ut vix ipsis Græcis cedere videantur. Homines scil. acumine & diligentia præstantes nihil in ullo literarum genere intactum reliquerunt. Nihil habuit Græcia eximium, quod non suum fecerint, de suo quæ non acceperant, multa non minus eximia protulerunt. Languescere sub barbaris Turcarum armis cæpere demum apud eos hæc studia, & cum honore pristino, pristinum etiam vigorem amisere.

Author legis Islamiticæ Mohammed] Refert Ahmed Josephi filius, alios secutus Authores, fuisse Pseudoprophetam istum primum qui appellatus fuerit Mohammed, vel Ahmed. Cui tamen hoc asserenti ne fidem adhibeamus facit quod ab Affohailio refert Ebn Chalican in vita celeberrimi Poetæ Pharazdaki. scil. Pag. 6.17. i.e. Non constat inter Arabes quempiam hoc nomine appellatum fuisse ante eum, tribus tantummodo exceptis. Quartus ergo sectæ Islamiticæ Author, Mohammed audiit, non primus, nisi forsan quod aliàs de Prophetico ipsius munere dicunt, fuisse ipsum Et v.lib.
Et v.lib. شرح شواهد المغني (Arabic note, marginal, reproduced as printed).

page.notes: Right margin carries "Pag. 6.17." and "Et v.lib." with Arabic words (شرح شواهد المغني), transcribed as printed. Arabic in the text (ابن محمد أو أحمد, لا يعرف في العرب, سمي بهذا الاسم قبله الا الثلاثة, أول الانبيا في الخلف وآخرهم) is only partly legible in the scan and is not reproduced with certainty; the last line of the text is cut off by the Arabic line at the foot. Some Greek and Hebrew-like forms in the main text are uncertain. Greek words are printed as Latin words in the text and are marked where doubtful. Several words, especially at line ends, are uncertain and should be checked against the original. The page has a catchword "Z" and a small Arabic word beneath the column.
